title: Netflix Admits AI Is Already Running on 300 Projects
description:
Netflix just admited AI is already running on 300 projects 🔥 Mostly post-production stuff, crowds and battle scenes. One series had 17 min of AI footage, shot twice as fast for half the cost. The wild part, studios been doing this quietly for years they even call it "don't ask, don't tell" 😅 300 projects isnt a experiment anymore, thats the new standard ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
